notes.title: The doors are OPEN
notes.content:
https://media.giphy.com/media/l3vRl7C542tWNrylG/source.gif

STANDBY is live!
That means that our special Prevent Cancer Foundation event with Games Done Quick is launched too.

Read about it here
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26083623/48a4dec347106c56fb55eae763258e2960451724.jpg

Back to the news: Wallpapers and Soundtrack DLC's are available for purchase.
By the way we've added 3 new tracks to the game recently. Let us know what you think about it ;)

Some hotfixes here:
- Speedrun timer is working properly now
- Quick Restart is active during the dash move
- Fixed pause menu text
- Fixed invisible rhombs bug
- Fixed french language

Thanks for all the bug reports, thoughts, ideas and translation fixes, please keep it coming!

Ping us through:
 our Discord channel
Facebook
or Twitter

notes.title: The crack in the reality!
notes.content:
https://media.giphy.com/media/3o6ZtrBGTJgVPqpp7O/source.gif

The release date for the game STANDBY is set to January 6, 6:00 PM PST! 
Get ready to delve into the glitchy game world and master the controls in this vibrant platformer! 
I hope you're hyped as we are, peeps!

Hit that “Add to wishlist” button and get notified when the doors to the glitch world will open!

notes.title: Speedrunning contest for our game demo is over and here are the winners!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26083623/4ed33101d98720f32cba1a272f98cfb2b685de92.png

Thank you everyone for participating in this contest!

It was definitely a new experience and new kind of interaction between a dev and speedrunners! We're glad that these many people have participated and there will be many more speedrun related and other contests and activities to come!

notes.title: The demo build was just updated!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26083623/48ec115d5e05bb4595de8b66c1c427cec78500cc.jpg

 The IGT timer in Speedrun mode now is continuous and won't reset or stop no matter what. 
 The reset button for gamepad is "back" (xbox one controller).
 The bug with timer being different each time is fixed.
 Restart SR, this is the new function that let's you to start the speedrun from level one fast, without going to the menu.

notes.title: STANDBY Demo available on Steam!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26083623/b7462e76e02865f09988b0c287a6a265827e44c7.jpg

 STANBY demo was released  a couple days ago and will continue up until the final release in the end of September. It contains first section of levels. 

So get your reflexes ready and take the trip:


    Slide your way through the spacetime with teleports
    Use the entourage to outsmart the corrupted security mechanisms
    Blast the obstacles away with a gun


Remember that it’s all about an escape from the decadent, cruel but visually stunning darkish neon lit world.

We are available for discussion in comments on Steam and on  -  Gamejolt 	

Also follow us on:
 Facebook	
 Twitter 	

STANDBY also has a  web-site
